notes.title: New update released!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The main focus of this update has been the throwing hammers. Many of you mentioned that this weapon was not interesting enough. After some experimentation, we reduced the damage from throws, but now the hammers can ricochet off multiple targets. Moreover, all explosions and other effects triggered by the throw can now activate multiple times! We hope these changes significantly improve your experience with this weapon.

We also spent a lot of time addressing the issue with achievements. As a result, we removed the achievement for having 17 blessings maxed out simultaneously, so it won’t prevent you from completing the game 100%. If you have all achievements except the one for 100% completion, just enter the infinite arena and complete one run. You don't need to score a lot of points — the main thing is that the run ends with the character's death. This will update your achievement data, and you should receive the final achievement.

We hope this resolves the achievement issues, but we'll continue to monitor your feedback closely!

Additionally, in this update, we fixed several bugs and improved localizations.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.1
Announcement of the upcoming update
notes.notes:
Hello!

First, our team wants to thank all the players who have battled in the fields of Hevalos at the Sentinels' call. Your feedback is why we make games.

But let's not bore you with thanks—here's what we have planned for the upcoming update.

We've noticed that many of you find the weapon economy lacking, and rightly so. We're excited to announce that very soon we'll release a patch to enhance meta-progression by offering more opportunities to spend your gold coins and earn green medals.

Additionally, we're refining the visual interface for streamers to interact with their audience. And, of course, there will be numerous smaller technical, visual, and audio fixes.

Thank you for your support. Sincerely, the A17 team.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.2.9
Call of Sentinels Update 0.4.2.5 is out now!
notes.notes:
Another solid update joins the fray!

[b]List of changes:[/b]

• New weapon system. Now instead of 2 different weapons, the character is armed with only one, but with 2 different types of attacks. The leveling is also shared for both weapons. Because of these changes, we had to wipe the saves, we apologize and promise that this is the last time (most likely!).
• A new arena has been added - Barbarian Camp, which introduced a new villain that players "Great Exile" will face off against.
• New enemies from the barbarian camp have been added in the survival mode.
• A bug with enemies freezing in the survival mode has been fixed.
• Numerous visual improvements.
• Performance improvement, support for the Yuryuzan fridge as a gaming platform.
• Minor rework of mission completion rewards and weapon upgrade locations in the armory.
• Redesigned UI.

Please, have fun and leave your reviews! As always, our team is working hard on QoL and gameplay improvements, and we need your feedback to become better! Feel free to comment and play!
